versions.changelog:
mailchimp-to-ghost v0.1.0

- Initial release: sync Mailchimp newsletters to Ghost blog via RSS.
- Converts Mailchimp HTML to clean markdown, preserving formatting, horizontal rules, buttons, and images.
- Downloads images from Mailchimp and uploads them to Ghost, updating references.
- Publishes newsletters as Ghost Lexical-format draft posts with deduplication to prevent duplicates.
- Provides cache management and guides on installation, configuration, and workflow.
